items: NEW ADMISSIONS: twins Mizan and Miran Zubin Engineer — Std. I, from Pune.
SSC: 1 student — Sarosh K. Bharucha (LD) scored 93.00%.
Navar: Maidhyarem K. Chinoy at Rustomframna Agyari, Dadar (12 May).
Maratab: Berjis K. Bharda at Udwada (7 May).
2 students left: Er. Sarosh Khushru Bharucha finished SSC; Rushad B. Katpitia stayed for a year and left for medical reasons after Std. V without Navar-Maratab.
Total Strength: same as last year — 14 students: 13 school + 1 college (Shyamak Sanjana, TYBAF).
Er. Zhian M. Turel (Std. IX) selected Head Boy of the school (Jul) and Mr. DPYA.
Er. Shahan Bhesadia (Std. IX) certified with Learning Disability in March. Maidyarem Chinoy (Std. IX) and Ziyan Nalladaru (Std. VIII) applied for certification in November.
Internal Bhantar exams in April and November.
New weekly classes for Spoken English by speech trainer Mrs. Nergesh A. Dodhy.
Visitors: Dastur Mehraban Poladi from Yazd and Prof. Dr. Salomi from Cambridge University visited the Institute and addressed the students; Dasturji Khurshedji Dastoor was also present (18 Dec 2024).
Visitors: about 30 youths from all over the world, participating in the “Return to Roots” programme, came to see the Institute and interact with the Principal and students (20 Mar).

Visitors: a group of about 30 people under Prof. Shernaz Nalwala, from The Asiatic Society's Mumbai Research Centre, came to the Institute for a field trip, “The Geography of Belief”, to understand the Zoroastrian religion and its sacred spaces (24 Aug).
Public launch of the film “Mobeds” at the MGMA, featuring the Institute. The film was made by Anna and Remi Sowa for SOAS.
In April and May the entire Institute was painted from inside, courtesy a donor. From November onwards another donor sponsored the complete roof work of the Institute.
Iran League Annual Prize Distribution programme and dinner (12 Apr).
Zoroastrian Saga Programme — Hum bandagi monajat and dinner (11 and 13 Apr).
Fun outings: Anand Mela of DPYA School; picnic to Pawana Lake and Tikona Fort (Feb); Jamshedi Navroz programme; Monsoon Walk and eat-out (Jun); Ekadashi Fair (Jul).
Movies: “Chhava” at Plaza (26 Feb), “Jaat” at Chitra (10 Apr) and “Mufasa” at Chitra.
School picnics: Primary to Kidzania (15 Feb); Musso of Solutions at Lower Parel (23 Sep).
On Khordad Sal students went to the play “Lage raho Bomanji” at the invitation of Er. Cyrus Dastur.
An outdoor walk and a treat for students at Dadar's McDonald's (30 Aug).
All Navar students, Bhantar teachers and the Principal attended a Nirang-din ritual at Banaji Limji Agyari (18 Jan).
Participated in the Narielwala fire temple Salgreh Jashan (14 Apr).
Empowering Mobeds: field trip to M.F. Cama Athornan Institute (25 Jan); field trip to the Alpaiwala Museum, Khareghat Colony, followed by snacks.

Gifts from donors: 1 new canteen-sized conventional oven from Adi Banaji through the Lions Club of Byculla (Oct); 1 new Aquaguard water filter machine from Adi Banaji through the Lions Club of Byculla (Dec).

Gifts from donors: a set of new formal clothes for all students (5 Apr); toys from a toy shop (16 Apr); a set of football uniforms for all students (22 Sep); a set of new T-shirts and track pants for all students (9 Nov).
DPYA School Sports (Jan): Maidyarem K. Chinoy — 100 m II, 200 m II, Relay I, Long Jump III; Shahan Bhesadia — Relay I; Huzan Z. Engineer — Shot Put I; Kaiwan K. Sidhwa — Long Jump III.
CUBS: Yazdan F. Panthaki — trophies for Regularity, Elocution and Best from Waste; Jehaun P. Sinor — trophy for Cooking.

All Parsi Sports (8–9 Feb): Maidyarem Chinoy — 100 m I, 400 m I, Long Jump I, High Jump I; he won the boys under-14 Championship. Shahan Bhesadia — 100 m hurdles I, 100 m II, Long Jump II, High Jump II. Zhian Turel — High Jump III.
Iran League Religious Quiz Competition (Jan): Shahan Bhesadia I; Pashang D. Karanjia II; Delyaz M. Panthaki II.
Iran League Western Vocal Competition (30 Nov): Er. Zhian Turel II; Mstr. Huzan Engineer II.
Iran League Gujarati Reading Competition (Sep): Pashang Karanjia II; Yazdan Panthaki III; Delyaz Panthaky III; Zahan Turel III; Shahan Bhesadia IV.

Monajat Competition (14 Dec): Er. Zhian Turel I & Trophy; Mstr. Pashang Karanjia I & Trophy; Mstr. Kaiwan K. Sidhwa II; Er. Barjis K. Bharda II; Mstr. Delyaz M. Panthaki III; Huzan Z. Engineer and Rushaad B. Katpitia — consolation.
Shahnameh Competition: Er. Zhian Turel I & Trophy; Shyamak Sanjana I; Delyaz Panthaky I; Kaiwan Sidhwa II; Pashang Karanjia — consolation.
BPA Bhantar competition (2 Feb): Juniors — Kaiwan K. Sidhwa I, Pashang D. Karanjia II, Rushad B. Katpitia III. Seniors — Zhian M. Turel I, Berjis K. Bharda II, Huzan Z. Engineer III.
DPYA School English Elocution competition: Huzan Engineer III.
